notes.title: Devlog #1 - Game Map
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Dear Players![/b]

As you know, this is the new page for our game. If you haven’t added it to your Wishlist yet, [b]Wishlist now please![/b]

[h3]🎮 One of the largest cities in simulation games:[/h3]
We are thrilled to finally reveal the silhouette of the city we've been working on for a long time! Soon, we will share an uncensored video showcasing the entire city, so you can see the world we have built for you in full detail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482169/1f5238647a36fc89175ed70859664086d156b25c.png[/img]

[h3]🗺️ About the map:[/h3]
Initially, the map was planned to be twice as large. However, to maintain the game's flow and density, we decided on the current size, ensuring the best experience for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482169/b5257f4809466b9c0c9c39d622b763f4a8cdda3c.png[/img]

[h3]📢 Join Us![/h3]
If you have any questions about the game or suggestions, feel free to join our Discord server. See you in the next Devlog!
